subject: Hero
text: The Hero starts at Level 1 with 19 HP, 6 MP, and 50 GP.

evidence.quote: You’ll start off at Level 1 with 19 HPs, 6 MPs, and 50 GP (monetary unit).

subject: Jackal
text: The Jackal yields 0 EXP and 0 GP, has no attacks, walks in a 'W' pattern, and is fought with the Sword.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         0
GP:                 0
Attacks:            none!
Preferred Weapon:   Sword (no choice!)

This Boss has a very low intelligence. It doesn’t attack you. It will just 
walk in a ‘W’ like pattern.

subject: Jackal
text: The Jackal is defeated with 8 slashes from the sword.

evidence.quote: the Attack button and you’ll kill it with 8 slashes.

subject: Dark Lord
text: Dark Lord pushes the hero off a cliff, causing him to fall and escape the castle to the World Map.

evidence.quote:
Here, Dark Lord will push you down! (Ahhh! How did Sumo survive?) After 
falling, you’ll regain control of Sumo again, but now you are in the World 
Map.

subject: Fuji
text: Defeating all monsters on the screen and talking to Hasim allows the heroine Fuji to join the party as an NPC who heals HP.

evidence.quote:
Defeat ALL monsters in this screen only. After defeating 
every monster (the clue is that there will be no more music), talk to the 
wounded boy....You will then offer the girl to come with you to see Bogard. The girl will 
join you. She is the Heroine in the game, Fuji. At this point, you finally 
have an NPC (non-playable character) with you. You can now ask her if your HP 
is low and she will gradually heal you.

subject: Inn
text: Resting at the Inn in Topple costs 10 GP.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering the Village, you’ll see the Inn 
right away. You can rest here for 10GP.

subject: Helmet
text: A helmet can be bought at the Weapon Shop in Topple for 140 GP.

evidence.quote: You can buy a more powerful helmet here. It costs 140 GPs.

subject: Keys
text: Keys can be purchased at the Item Shop in Topple in sets of 4 for 30 GP.

evidence.quote:
After 
that, go inside the Item Shop and buy 2 Sets of Keys (each set contains 4) for 
30 GPs.

subject: Mattock
text: Talking to Bogard three times reveals his identity and opens the north room where the Mattock is obtained.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering, you’ll see an old man to the left. If you talk to him, he will 
just walk away from you. But on the third time, he will notice the pendant of 
Fuji. Then, he will finally reveal himself as Bogard....When the door opens, go in and take the Mattock.

subject: Rocks
text: Standing in front of rocks blocking the path and pressing the B Button with the Mattock equipped removes them.

evidence.quote:
upon entering, equip the Mattock that Bogard gave you. Then, stand in front of 
the Rocks that block the path to the south. Press the B Button to remove them.

subject: Battle Axe
text: The general store on the World Map sells a Battle Axe for 150 GP.

evidence.quote:
Here, you’ll find a general store. You can buy a 
Battle Axe for 150 GPs.

subject: Cure
text: Sleeping in the bed at Kett's triggers a scene with Fuji where the player learns the Cure spell.

evidence.quote:
Here, sleep on the bed by walking to it. You’ll automatically sleep. 
During the night, you’ll have a short scene with Fuji. She will now let you 
read the Magic book of Cure! Then you’ll automatically learn your first magic, 
Cure!

subject: Chest
text: Defeating all Lizardmen on the screen causes a chest containing the Bronze Key to appear.

evidence.quote:
Now, defeat ALL of the Lizardmen in this 
screen. After doing that, a chest will appear in the middle. Examine it and 
you’ll get the Bronze Key.

subject: Mysterious Man
text: Talking to the man upon entering Cave of Marsh allows him to join the party.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering, you’ll see a man. Talk to him and he will tell you that a lot 
of girls disappeared at Kett’s. He will offer you his help. Accept his help.

subject: Switch
text: Stepping on the switch at the bottom of the screen reveals a ladder leading down at the top left.

evidence.quote:
Here, step 
on the switch at the bottom of the screen. A ladder leading down will show up 
at the top left of the screen.

subject: Chest
text: Breaking the bottom center wall with the Mattock opens a path to a chest containing the Sickle.

evidence.quote:
Now, if you strike the 
bottom center wall, you’ll here a cranking sound. Use your mattock to destroy 
the wall and reveal a new path. Now, go down south to the next screen. In 
here, get the chest that you see in the middle of the screen. You’ll receive 
the Sickle.

subject: Chest Switch Puzzle
text: Pushing the chest onto the lower left switch reveals a ladder going down at the upper right.

evidence.quote:
Push 
the chest into the switch on the lower left. A ladder going down will appear 
at the upper right.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating all enemies in the locked room causes a chest containing an Iron Shield to appear.

evidence.quote:
Defeat all enemies on the screen 
and a chest will appear. It contains an Iron Shield.

subject: Floor Switch Puzzle
text: Walking across the topmost panel and using the Mattock to break rocks allows both floor switches to be activated, revealing a ladder in the lower right.

evidence.quote:
Now, walk on the topmost panel to reach the 
upper switch. Now, use your mattock to break the rocks. After that, break the 
lower set of rocks to reach the lower floor switch. Upon switching both floor 
switches, a ladder leading down will appear on the lower right corner.

subject: 2-Headed Dragon
text: The 2-Headed Dragon gives 10 EXP and 95 GP, attacks with fireballs, and is weak to the Sickle when hit in the head.

evidence.quote:
BOSS: 2-HEADED DRAGON
#############################################################################
EXP gained:         10
GP:                 95
Attacks:            Fireballs
Preferred Weapon:   Sickle

This battle will be hard, if you don’t know what to do. The only way to damage 
it is to hit it in the head. The best strategy here is to use the sickle and 
always stay below the hydra.

subject: 2-Headed Dragon
text: Standing facing the direction of the 2-Headed Dragon's fireballs with the Iron Shield equipped negates the fireballs.

evidence.quote:
If you are cornered, and you have the Iron Shield, you can just stand in front 
of the fireballs (facing their direction) and the shield will negate it. In 
simpler terms, you can block the fireballs.

subject: Chests
text: Defeating the 2-Headed Dragon reveals two chests, the first containing Fire magic and the second containing the Mirror.

evidence.quote:
After the fight, you’ll see 2 chests appear in the middle. The first chest 
contains your second magic, Fire. After getting the chest, hack it away and 
get the second chest for the Mirror.

subject: Chest
text: A chest through the locked north door in Kett's contains the Chain Flail.

evidence.quote:
Here, use a key to open the north 
door and go through it. Now, you’ll see a chest. Get it for the Chain Flail!

subject: Chain Flail
text: Crossing the gap to the pole requires waiting for will power to fill up before using the chain.

evidence.quote:
Here, there’s a gap on the floor. First of all, you MUST 
wait until your will power to fill up. Then, use the chain on the pole on the 
other side. You’ll never reach it when using normal chain attacks.

subject: Fuji
text: Examining the second casket from the right on the lowest row rescues Fuji.

evidence.quote:
There are 
caskets here. Go to the 2nd from the right casket on the lowest row. You’ll 
now get Fuji back.
